method: Official license pages were requested directly; this build environment's network policy blocked every official educational host (HTTP CONNECT 403 / DNS failure). Where an official source-code repository on GitHub/GitLab carried the license text, it was read verbatim ([REPO]). Everything else rests on search-engine snippets restricted to the official domain ([SNIPPET]) and is classified Unverified or Permission required until the live page is read.
